description: This file defines the 'SavingsAccountSummary' class, which encapsulates summary details of a savings account such as total deposits, withdrawals, interest earned, fees, penalties, and account balances. It includes methods for updating and calculating these summaries based on transactions, as well as handling interest posting periods.

classes.name: SavingsAccountSummary
classes.description: A final class that summarizes all financial and interest-related totals of a savings account, including deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, penalties, and balances. It provides methods to update these summaries based on transactions and interest periods.

methods.name: updateSummary
methods.description: Updates the account summary totals based on a wrapper and list of transactions, recalculating balances and interest postings.

methods.name: updateSummaryWithPivotConfig
methods.description: Adjusts the summary based on specific transaction details, including reversals, transaction types, and interest posting.

methods.name: updateFromInterestPeriodSummaries
methods.description: Aggregates interest earned over multiple posting periods and updates related timestamps.

methods.name: isLessThanOrEqualToAccountBalance
methods.description: Checks if a given amount is less than or equal to the current account balance.

methods.name: getAccountBalance
methods.description: Returns the account balance as a Money object for a specified currency.

methods.name: getAccountBalance (getter)
methods.description: Returns the raw BigDecimal value of the account balance.

methods.name: setAccountBalance
methods.description: Sets the account balance to a specified BigDecimal value.

methods.name: getTotalInterestPosted
methods.description: Returns the total interest posted accumulated in the summary.

methods.name: getLastInterestCalculationDate
methods.description: Returns the date when interest was last calculated.

methods.name: setInterestPostedTillDate
methods.description: Sets the date till which interest has been posted.

methods.name: getInterestPostedTillDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date till which interest has been posted.

methods.name: setRunningBalanceOnPivotDate
methods.description: Sets the running balance on the pivot date used during interest calculations.

methods.name: getRunningBalanceOnPivotDate
methods.description: Returns the running balance on the interest pivot date.
